name: astro-canvas-core
description: IO, math, spectra, plotting, archive fetch and the Python code node. Ships with the app.

name: astro-canvas-rbcodes
description: The rbcodes science kernels as nodes: equivalent widths, continuum fitting, redshift search, multi-spectrum line identification and IFU cube tools.

templates.name: Absorption line measurement
templates.description: Load a spectrum, set a redshift, fit the continuum, mark the integration range and measure W and log N.

templates.name: Redshift search
templates.description: Cross-correlate against templates and a picket fence, then accept a redshift in the z editor.

templates.name: Multi-spectrum line identification
templates.description: Stack several spectra in velocity space and identify absorbers across them.

templates.name: IFU cube tools
templates.description: Moment maps, aperture extraction and ds9 region round-tripping for integral-field cubes.
